description: This is a shell script containing helper functions and test cases for comparing diff algorithms, particularly for C source code files. It creates C code snippets, computes their hashes, and runs various diff tests with different diff algorithms and attributes.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Sets up and runs diff tests comparing two C code files with embedded different algorithms, using git attributes and configuration, verifying diff outputs and diffstat results.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Creates two entirely different text files and tests diff output with a specific diff algorithm.
